mentions.name: HomeBidder
mentions.description: This tool estimates a realistic bid price for houses based on comps, adding confidence intervals, adjustments for lot size and fixer status, and quality-of-life information such as transit access and pollution levels. It is heavily optimized for San Francisco and is being iterated and validated on other cities.
mentions.problem: Listing prices on sites like Zillow are artificially low, making it hard to know a realistic amount to bid on a house.
mentions.audience: A tool for prospective home buyers who want a realistic bid price instead of relying on artificially low listing prices; initially built for the author's own house-hunting needs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building HomeBidder (https://homebidder-web.fly.dev), a tool for figuring out a realistic bid price for houses. I got sick of seeing artificially low listing prices on sites like Zillow so built this tool to give me a more realistic number based on comps.
